image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a small turtle, likely a mud or musk turtle, situated in grassy terrain. The turtle has a dark, high-domed carapace with visible scutes and some algae/dirt accumulation. Its head is extended, showing a textured, brownish-grey skin tone with a distinct yellow stripe behind the eye. One front limb is visible, appearing stout with claws. The background consists of blurred green grass and soil.
